This implies that Verapamil may influence the activity or function of Activin receptor type-1 through its interaction with ABCG1. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the relationship is inferred through a chain of targets, and further experimental validation would be required to confirm the direct interaction between Verapamil and Activin receptor type-1.
